Subject: Request: compact bundle of SAML/SCIM assertion samples and owner roster

Hi Ana —

Thanks again for the call earlier. MedWise is moving through the SIG/SOC2 intake and the audit team asked for a minimal sample package we can point reviewers to rather than sharing the full production logs. Would you be able to send a compact bundle that includes:  

- 3–5 SAML assertion samples covering an OIDC session + service account assertion (redact PII/session ids)
- A SCIM delta sample showing a create/update/delete for a user and a group membership change
- A short mapping of roles -> example attributes to demonstrate least-privilege mappings (CSV or text)

I attached a tiny template that shows the field names we usually need. If you can drop the files here or send them to security@redwood.com that works. Goal is to produce a single zip with 2–3 example artifacts and an owner roster (who to ask for deeper logs).

Attachments: request_template_fields.csv (template)

Appreciate it — aiming to get this to our auditor by Friday.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
